subject: STABLE texture-opus #5: XR render targets (c6l 2x fmt=554 'w30r' usage 5) + private XR textures + XR pipelines
body: (a) IOSurface XR textures with usage 5 (sample+RT) get the RGBA16F shadow (usage 5); after a job renders into it the shadow is ENCODED back to XR codes (nearest code under the generated decode tables: identity for every code of linear/sRGB/alpha tables, BGR10_XR bits 30/31 set as Metal writes them, BGRA10_XR alpha clamped to 384..894). (b) Private/memoryless (0x20/0x30) XR textures 552-555 allocate as RGBA16F internally (apiFormat=XR; no CPU access exists for them). (c) render_pipeline.inc generic attachment loop: XR colour formats compile as RGBA16F targets (1 hunk, diagnostics keep the requested format). Blending into XR targets happens in fp16 (Metal's XR blend is not modelled exactly by the translator either: documented approximation); stores match Metal's half-then-encode within the nearest-code rule. Test texture_format_frontend_test 2d5c7bad: XR_RENDER_WRITEBACK ok=4 (all 1024 codes x 4 formats), XR_TARGETS ok=2 (554 pipeline -> colorFormat 115; draws into private 554 and into a w30r usage-5 surface, status 4, write-back proven). Hashes: render_encoder.inc e4ab855b, compositor_submit.inc 11294e67, render_pipeline.inc f680cc56 (also contains encode's uncommitted hunks), render_encoder_host_test.inc 84438138 (private 554 776x24 expectation now RGBA16F rows 6208/148992 - deliberate). Gates: ARM64 frontend objects PASS, render harness PASS, CA test PASS 41, iosurface_cpu PASS, ycbcr_decode PASS, integration 1005/2 (known CA 66/42 only; inert-pass test fixed by its owner meanwhile). Note: tests/frontend_jm_test.py links research/nord2-host-air/target (stale since Oct 25; already missing plan_generic_specialized/native_dispatch_tg before my change) - not a current gate. Snapshot gpu/build/texture-coverage-20261026/p5-xr-target-stable. Device build needs: iOS Rust staticlib rebuild (immutable_sampler symbol, #3).
